parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.000946 > 0.997442). It seems the WARMUP_RATIO 0.10 increase at LR 0.06 didn't immediately yield gains in this window. Reverting to my best: D8/AR64/LR0.06/warmup0.05. Following the team's strong LR-down trend, I'll next test reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to see if it stabilizes better at this capacity.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 to follow the team-wide trend of lower learning rates improving stability and performance for the D8/AR64 configuration.
